text:
deploy-bot: Starting hotpatch deploy to production: tag `v1.12.7-hotfix-2026-03-20` from commit `abcdef12`.
Environment: production. Strategy: canary -> full. Estimated rollout ~6m. Deploy command: `./deploy --tag v1.12.7-hotfix-2026-03-20 --env prod --strategy canary` :rocket:

Alex M.: ack. Are we pinning traffic to the dedicated GPU pool for this? want to avoid noisy neighbor effects.

Priya S.: pinned routing to `dedicated-gpu-pool-3`, added temporary rate limit bump. no db migrations in this deploy.

Jordan L.: running smoke tests now after canary. I'll post results.

deploy-bot: Canary started (3 hosts). Will wait for health checks and smoke test webhook.

infra-bot: Smoke test results: 3/3 canaries healthy. Checks: auth ok, inference path ok, embeddings sanity ok. Logs: `embed-service` no NPE during canary.

Sasha K.: thanks. rolling to rest of prod in 2m unless we see regressions.

Alex M.: seeing a small spike in 5xx from `embed-service` in the first non-canary shard: short windowed spike from 15:41:02 - 15:41:18. attaching snippet:
```
[15:41:05] embed-service ERROR: NullPointer at EmbeddingCache.java:48
[15:41:06] 5xx count +12
```

Priya S.: can you confirm if that's during warmup? any correlation with traffic burst? @Jordan L. can you check telemetry?

Jordan L.: checking. Telemetry shows increased QPS on that shard because a background job retried. error rate localized to node `prod-embed-12`.

Alex M.: suggestion: rollback that node only or roll back full tag? prefer minimal surface but risk of cross-node inconsistency.

Sasha K.: given this is a hotfix and we don't want partial state drift, I'd vote full rollback to previous stable `v1.12.6` while we triage. call it.

Priya S.: agree. rollback plan: 1) pause rollout 2) run `./deploy --tag v1.12.6 --env prod --strategy immediate` 3) validate smoke tests 4) monitor for 15m. I'll coordinate.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollback to `v1.12.6` (commit `1234abcd`). Command queued: `./deploy --tag v1.12.6 --env prod --strategy immediate` :leftwards_arrow_with_hook:

infra-bot: Rolling back services: prod-embed-* replaced with instances running `v1.12.6`. Drain + terminate started.

deploy-bot: Rollback in progress: 9/9 nodes replaced.

infra-bot: Rollback complete. Healthchecks: all services green. 5xx back to baseline.

Alex M.: confirming latency and error budget back to normal. no more NPE in `embed-service` logs for 5m.

Jordan L.: will open a quick follow-up PR to add guard on cache read and add additional unit test to reproduce. tagging for next patch cycle.

Priya S.: filing post-mortem doc and will schedule a paused redeploy once fix is validated in staging. Good catch and fast decisioning everyone.

deploy-bot: Thread closed: hotpatch `v1.12.7-hotfix-2026-03-20` rolled back to `v1.12.6`. Follow-ups: #infra-postmortem-123. :white_check_mark:
